The two frames are pixel-aligned, but figure 2 was shot under noticeably different lighting, so large areas of the two images differ in brightness without anything being wrong with the part. Which region contains a real defect?
(A) [0.7549, 0.3914, 0.8749, 0.5114]
(B) [0.2525, 0.1680, 0.3725, 0.2880]
(C) [0.0577, 0.7726, 0.1777, 0.8926]
(D) No real defect — the two frames differ only in lighting.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
